text: With the adoption of the Vision Zero Road Safety Plan, there have been increased requests to my office for speed limit reductions on local roads in Ward 12. -Lester Avenue- Lester Avenue runs from Keele Street to Glenhaven Street. The road has a two-way operation and a sidewalk on both sides of the road. The legal speed limit is 50 km/hr. Immaculate Conception Catholic Church is located on the south side of Lester Avenue. I am requesting that the speed limit on the full length of Lester Avenue from Keele Street to Glenhaven Street be reduced to 30 km/hr. -Bicknell Avenue- Bicknell Avenue runs from Rogers Road to Eglinton Avenue West. The road has a two-way operation with a sidewalk on both sides of the road. The legal speed limit is 40 km/hr. There are two schools located on Bicknell Avenue.
